## Summary

Describe the change, motivation, and outcome. Link related issues.

Closes #

## Context Updates

- [ ] Endpoints updated? Run `npm run context:endpoints` and commit changes
- [ ] Schema changed? Run `npm run context:schema` and commit changes
- [ ] ADR added/updated if this is a significant decision

## Security Checklist

- [ ] No secrets committed; envs documented/updated
- [ ] Tenant scoping applied to new queries
- [ ] Input validation for new endpoints
- [ ] Considered logging sensitivity (no sensitive payloads)

## Screenshots / Notes

If UI changes, attach screenshots. Include rollout/backout notes if relevant.
